items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well that was with Billy Macanick, wasn't it?

ctx.x: I Don't Know. I Don't Know. I Don't Know. It's on the back of which one? Isabella. Well that was with Billy Macanick, wasn't it? Jimmy Bertrand.
Donnell Howard. Jimmy Blight. I Won't Give You None. And what's on the back of? Isabella.
